title: CmdPal: Render Adaptive Cards bar charts natively

confidence.rationale: Explicit fixed-axis overrides and the following range.Min condition directly contradict the unconditional comment; executable behavior is unchanged.

proposed_comments.body:
### Describe the computed axis minimum, not an unconditional zero baseline

**Severity:** `low` (non-blocking documentation)

`BarChartModel.GetAxisRange` passes explicit `YMin`/`YMax` to `ChartScale.Compute`, and the vertical baseline is clamped into that computed range. The existing comment therefore overstates that bars always start at zero. The following condition correctly tests `range.Min`; describe that condition without changing rendering.

```suggestion
            // Omit the minimum label only when the computed axis minimum is zero.
```

The complete original and suggested files parse successfully and have identical executable tokens. This suggestion changes only the comment, not axis calculation or labels.
proposed_comments.title: Describe the computed axis minimum
